name: Transport By Air 4
definition: Information related to the transportation of goods by air.

DepartureAirport.name: Departure Airport
DepartureAirport.definition: Place from where the goods must leave.

DestinationAirport.name: Destination Airport
DestinationAirport.definition: Place where the goods must arrive.

FlightNumber.name: Flight Number
FlightNumber.definition: Flight number allocated by the airline that is carrying the goods from an airport of departure to an airport of destination;.

AirCarrierName.name: Air Carrier Name
AirCarrierName.definition: Identifies the party that is responsible for the conveyance of the goods from one place to another.

AirCarrierCountry.name: Air Carrier Country
AirCarrierCountry.definition: Country in which the carrier of the goods, for example, shipping company, is located or registered.

CarrierAgentName.name: Carrier Agent Name
CarrierAgentName.definition: Name of the carrier's (for example, shipping company's) agent that acts on behalf of the carrier and may be the issuer of transport documents relating to the underlying shipment.

CarrierAgentCountry.name: Carrier Agent Country
CarrierAgentCountry.definition: Country of registration of the carrier's (for example, shipping company's) agent that acts on behalf of the carrier and may be the issuer of transport documents relating to the underlying shipment.
